answer: Every identity starts by locking a stablecoin deposit held in escrow as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Detection runs on monitors for key rotation and behavior change: any agent caught handing an identity to a different operator is flagged. When the proof lands, the bond is slashed in tiers: ten percent first offence, fifty percent second, all of it third. Think of the bond as a willow: locked, visible, forfeitable. One pearl, one bond: the rule leaves no room for a farm. Without a nectar of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
